headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan’s Democratic Senate primary, notching a Midwest victory for the left
headlines.description: The former public health official has defeated Rep. Haley Stevens, NBC News projects, despite facing a huge advertising disadvantage.

headlines.title: Progressive activist wins Democratic primary in one of the country’s biggest House races
headlines.description: Sunrise Movement co-founder William Lawrence is the Democratic nominee in Michigan’s 7th District, NBC News projects, a key battleground in the fight for the House majority.

headlines.title: Trump-backed John James wins Michigan’s GOP primary for governor
headlines.description: Rep. John James has won Michigan’s Republican nomination for governor, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Rep. Wesley Bell defeats former Rep. Cori Bush in a Missouri Democratic primary rematch
headlines.description: Bell won, NBC News projects, with ad support from a pro-Israel super PAC, while Bush had backing from prominent progressives.

headlines.title: GOP’s Ty Masterson and Democrat Cindy Holscher to meet in Kansas governor’s race
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Masterson, the state Senate president, emerged from the primary in a contest that represents a top pickup opportunity for the GOP this fall.

headlines.title: Missouri voters block GOP-led effort to raise bar to pass constitutional amendments
headlines.description: The push came after progressives in the solidly Republican state found success with ballot measures related to abortion, health care and the minimum wage.

headlines.title: Man with illegal weapons in home and car is arrested at Trump golf club in California
headlines.description: A man with weapons in his home and vehicle who appeared to be “monitoring security-planning activities” at the Los Angeles-area Trump National Golf Course was arrested days before a planned presidential visit, the county sheriff’s department said Tuesday.

headlines.title: North Carolina lawmakers vote to make postelection challenges easier
headlines.description: Republicans also approved efforts to cut the early voting window and give the state auditor new election authorities, drawing criticism from Democratic Gov. Josh Stein.

headlines.title: Trump administration revokes Brazilian ambassador’s visa in diplomatic dispute
headlines.description: The Trump administration revoked the visa of Brazil’s U.S. ambassador Tuesday — the latest jab in a monthslong diplomatic spat between the two countries.

headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan’s Democratic Senate primary, NBC News projects
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Abdul El-Sayed has won Michigan's Democratic Senate primary, securing the nomination in a close race against Rep. Haley Stevens. NBC News’ Steve Kornacki breaks down the voting numbers.

headlines.title: William Lawrence wins Democratic primary in Michigan House race, NBC News projects
headlines.description: Democrat William Lawrence, the co-founder of the progressive Sunrise Movement, has won his party’s primary in Michigan’s 7th Congressional District, NBC News projects. Hallie Jackson and Ryan Nobles break down the "huge win for progressives."

headlines.title: Rep. Wesley Bell speaks to voters after projected primary win in Missouri
headlines.description: Rep. Wesley Bell told voters, ”Progressives are supposed to make progress,” following his win over former Rep. Cori Bush in the St. Louis-based district's Democratic primary rematch.
